description: This file contains a Validation object with functions for validating email addresses, passwords, and password confirmation. It leverages regex for email validation and provides user feedback messages.

classes.name: Validation
classes.description: A singleton object providing validation functions for user input fields such as email, password, and password confirmation.

methods.name: emailError
methods.description: Validates an email string, returning an error message if invalid or null if valid.

methods.name: passwordError
methods.description: Validates a password string, returning an error message if invalid or null if valid.

methods.name: confirmPasswordError
methods.description: Checks if the confirmation password matches the original password, returning an error message if not or null if valid.
